searchText: I got the same exact error. It's weird. I add the randomness with the mouse and the secret. This brings me to `Bind Your Contribution`. I then go to SIWE portal and use the same wallet to sign again. This brings me back to the `Bind your contribution` and I get stuck with the same exact error. I think something weird happens when SIWE is selected TBH <nicoserranop> Could you check if after pressing "Submit" in the entropy page, the console logs are showing "PoTpubkeys generated"? The error I identified was that we were not waiting for the async potPubKey generation function to execute before navigating to the bind your contribution page. https://twitter.com/kiliconu/status/1606358657985282065?s=20&t=Qd6SYprD1kuiGOGMmG2wSQ for any teams looking for support on this front, Onur is offering to help! BTW I have a branch for towers-of-pau using kilic if anyone wants to take a peek

excerpts.content:
<nicoserranop> Could you check if after pressing "Submit" in the entropy page, the console logs are showing "PoTpubkeys generated"?
